nodes.label: Shared Linux feature performance sampler
nodes.rationale: Read-only collection with Ember already running; no synthetic load, feature toggles, capture streams or provider connections.

nodes.label: Baseline/off with the same conversation workload
nodes.rationale: A latency baseline uses repeatable speech, not silence. Idle/resource-only runs cannot pass latency budgets.

nodes.label: Feature active/on comparison
nodes.rationale: Enable only the feature under test through normal configuration, warm up and repeat the same speech workload.

nodes.label: Normal combined-feature workload
nodes.rationale: After isolated comparisons, collect the normal feature mix; the sampler itself does not generate stress.

nodes.label: Matched board, build, devices, model, network, duration and utterances
nodes.rationale: Warm up and let temperature settle; repeat runs to separate provider/network variation from feature cost.

nodes.label: System and parent/descendant CPU measurements
nodes.rationale: System CPU is machine-wide 0–100%; process CPU is core-based and may exceed 100%. Newly seen child CPU starts at its next sample; short processes may be missed.

nodes.label: System RAM and parent/descendant RSS
nodes.rationale: Summed RSS can double-count shared pages and is not PSS. System RAM includes other applications and the sampler.

nodes.label: Exposed NPU load and telemetry availability
nodes.rationale: Reads vendor percentage load files; unavailable is null, not zero. This does not prove NPU correctness or measure NPU memory.

nodes.label: Hottest exposed thermal-zone temperature
nodes.rationale: Missing sensors cannot establish safety; sampled peaks cannot rule out brief spikes or throttling.

nodes.label: Recognition, reply-audio and scheduled-playback latency
nodes.source_location: Feature performance check / Results and interpretation
nodes.rationale: Existing local speech estimates and DAC scheduling are reused; no Gemini internal or acoustic timing is claimed.

nodes.label: Explicit added-p95 speech-end-to-playback budget
nodes.rationale: --max-added-latency-ms compares p95 playback latency against baseline. The documented 250 ms is an example review budget, not a certified limit.

nodes.label: Explicit CPU/RSS/temperature/audible peak requirements
nodes.rationale: Release checks supply all needed board/workload budgets; mean/p95/max comparisons use metrics available in both runs.

nodes.label: Required unavailable or stale measurements fail
nodes.rationale: Do not mount debugfs or change driver permissions as a side effect; --require-npu requires telemetry and --max-npu-percent adds a load budget.

nodes.label: MEASURED versus PASS and exit-status meaning
nodes.rationale: MEASURED has no supplied budgets; PASS applies only to supplied requirements. Exit 1 is an unmet requirement; exit 2 is a collection/input/runtime error.

nodes.label: Aggregate JSON performance reports under .local-review
nodes.rationale: Reports contain counts/mean/p95/peaks, baseline deltas, board/kernel, duration and failures; never transcripts or raw status snapshots.

nodes.label: Minimum speech turns and deduplicated timing-window coverage
nodes.rationale: Only speech ending during the window is included. Leave time for final playback and manually record unrecognized utterances that may lack matched timing rows.

nodes.label: Separate explicit-PID cold-start collection
nodes.rationale: Warmed scenarios do not measure boot time.

nodes.label: Sampler logic regression suite
nodes.rationale: python tests/run.py --feature performance exercises offline logic; real readings require a separate live Linux-board scenario.

nodes.label: Every feature/changed selection includes performance and overall checks
nodes.rationale: Offline tests do not invent readings or launch a live scenario.

nodes.label: Every feature PR records off/on/combined performance evidence
nodes.rationale: Record CPU, parent/child RAM, NPU availability/load, temperature and recognition/reply/playback latency against explicit budgets; explain missing sensors and misses.

nodes.label: Shared feature performance source and test ownership
nodes.rationale: devops/performance/ and tests/performance/ own sampling and regression checks; board measurements remain pending.
